mission.title: Recruit This
mission.description: Investigate the recruitment emails Zion is sending to bluepills.

npc.say:
Hey, you here for the job listing? Listen, I gotta tell ya something... we got a dress code here.
You serious about getting yourself a job? Then you gotta get serious about how you dress! People aren't gonna take you seriously in that getup! I swear, kids these days...
I don't remember requesting any help...

Oh, hey, are you from I.S.? Yeah, listen, I got this screen where it says 'Press any key'. Thing is, I can't find the 'Any' key.
I'm pretty sure it's broken, but you can check it out if you want.
You're supposed to have your keycard displayed at all times, you know.

phase.briefing:
I understand that you are currently hunting down of the Assassin. Something else has occurred that requires your attention.
The followers of Zion may be overstepping the bounds of the Truce. They are allowed to awaken those who wish to be awake. We believe that their recruitment and propaganda are becoming... excessive.
Go to the location indicated. Observe the recruitment procedures in use and report any discrepancies to me immediately.

enter.say: This office building looks nondescript, but apparently these bluepills have been receiving some sort of communications from Zion. Take a look around in there.
Better check the computer in this room.

done.say: Take a look at the computer in this room.
Hey, that's the same email! These people don't exactly seem like the "questioning the nature of existence" type, either... well, let's get out of this building and see what else Gray has.
Um, are you checking our email? I swear, I didn't mean to click that one link. Total accident. Seriously.

phase.briefing: The next location is a similar office setting. Investigate all computers on the site.

enter.say: Here it is. Same drill: check out all the computers you find in there.

done.say: Hey, that's the same message we saw at the last place...
Wow. Is this really the kind of mouth breather Zion recruits these days?
No way! What'd you do to fix it? Can you show me where the 'Any' key is so I can fix it next time?
Hey! What are you doing on my computer?
Okay, that's just ridiculous! They're using junk mail to recruit bluepills! I think we've seen enough, {player}.

phase.briefing:
Such flagrant and widespread use of unsolicited emails displays a disregard for the Truce. There is also a whiff of... desperation about it.
I have tracked the originating location of those emails. Proceed there and use whatever means you consider necessary to deal with the email authors.

enter.say: Okay, this is the place. You've got free rein in there -- go to town.
What the-- he isn't a Zion operative! Take them down!

done.say: I think you can clear out of there now, and we'll see what Gray has to say about this.

mission.finish:
This encounter was very... intriguing, {player}. These commandos currently represent an unknown quantity. We require time to consider this new development.
In the meantime, continue your efforts against the Assassin. His deletion is of the utmost importance to us.
